text:
jamal: midnight handoff — seeing KV cache pressure in eu-west1, 95p tail latency up ~4x since 23:10. Embedding ingest queue backed up. Primary mitigation: dropped batching window to 20ms, enabled burst nodes (dedicated-burst pool). telemetry: https://grafana/redwood/dashboard/kv-latency :warning:

alex: noticed a few 503s from embed-ingest workers, looks like redis evictions spiked. PR #1427 still in flight (lazy-eviction fix), not safe to merge for this window.

maria: on it, can run eviction_policy=volatile-lru on the buffer cache briefly. pinging infra to confirm write-through won't explode SLOs.

jamal: thanks. I've put a temporary routing rule to route 10% of requests to fallback model variant (redwood-mini-quant) to reduce memory pressure. If errors drop, we can ramp.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-5123 — KV eviction storm in eu-west1. Linked runbook: /runbooks/kv-evictions

chandra: heads-up — CDN health is fine. This looks internal to serving layer. Can someone grab heap profile from one of the embed workers? command:
```
ssh embed-03 && sudo gcore -o /tmp/heap.$(date +%s) $(pidof embed_worker)
```

alex: grabbing heap and logs now, will upload to /tmp and post link. taking ownership of investig for next 30m.

maria: infra confirmed volatile-lru toggle safe for 15m -> applying now.

jamal: action items: alex will collect heap + logs, maria toggles eviction policy and monitors, chandra check routing and k8s HPA, I'll keep traffic shaping + fallbacks. escalate to SRE if errors > 1% over 5m.

alex: uploaded logs: https://artifacts/redwood/heap-dumps/embed-03/2312348000.tar.gz , tail of logs shows repeated ENOMEM then restarts.

maria: eviction policy toggled. immediate drop in evictions and 95p latency down ~30% in last 2m :thumbsup: 

jamal: nice. keeping watch. next steps: keep fallback at 10% for 15m, if stable after 15m ramp to 30% then revert batching window to normal. If errors resurge, hotfix PR for eager eviction apply.

chandra: noted. I'll also create a short postmortem template in #postmortems if we hit sev threshold. tagging @oncall to make sure incident doc is updated.

oncall-bot: Reminder: /incident update INC-2026-5123 — set severity to P2 if customer impact detected.

maria: no customer-facing errors so far, internal retries only. setting internal flag.

jamal: good. I'm handing over to alex for the next shift at 04:00 UTC. please ping in thread if anything changes. signing off for a bit.

alex: taking over. will keep monitoring for next 1h, will post hourly updates. :coffee: 

maria: thanks team. I have a PR prepared with improved eviction heuristics (WIP) — will link in comments: https://git.redwood/pr/1432

chandra: adding HPA tweak to infra playbook, will submit terraform change for review.

alex: last note — if anyone needs to trigger quick fallback, command:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood/ops/route -d '{"prob":0.3, "variant":"mini-q"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'`

jamal: thanks all. handing off. /end
